lines.text: Why are microwaved leftovers hot at the edge, cold in the middle?
Waves bounce off the metal walls and overlap, leaving strong and weak spots.
The turntable carries food through them, but in thick food the waves mostly heat the outer layers; the middle waits for heat to spread inward.
So stir halfway, spread food evenly, and let it stand so the heat evens out.
